## Editorial review

- [ ] The article facts are supported by the original source.
- [ ] Analysis is clearly separated from reported facts.
- [ ] Thai copy is concise, natural, and not clickbait.
- [ ] Source links are original sources and do not contain tracking parameters.
- [ ] Categories and tags are relevant and limited in scope.
- [ ] No prompt text, JSON fragments, placeholders, or fake citations are present.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
